scoring_scale: 0-100 per category; 90 means genuinely close visual correspondence. Scores are independent for this pass and do not inherit prior values.

pass_gate.required: Every room must score at least 90 in lighting, art_style and layout_fidelity after iteration.
pass_gate.reason: Pass 07 is stronger in dressing and locker construction, but every room retains at least one camera/material/light mismatch below the 90 correspondence threshold.

BRIEFING.overall_read: TV, briefing boards, discipline graphic, console, exactly two benches, rug and open portal read clearly. The framing proportions still differ from the target, the right foliage is broad/repeated, and the target's warm fill and wall-note density are richer.

HALL.overall_read: The poster headline is now inside the frame, and the corridor's major equipment is visible. Poster and right safety props are still larger/shifted relative to target, plants and new props remain simpler, and the light is flatter/cooler in the distance.

LOCKER.overall_read: The corner render preserves the pod, two benches, clear portal and physical locker room. DETAIL_FourLockers verifies two physical banks of two matching bodies. Remaining gaps are framing scale, dark locker/pod recesses and simpler foliage/material detail.

limitations: Corner-vs-target scores use only the three REFERENCE_*.png images. DETAIL_FourLockers.png was used solely to verify the physical four-locker/two-bank arrangement and did not replace the corner visual comparison.
Pixel evidence is approximate visual measurement from 1600x900 renders; it distinguishes scale/aim mismatch from actual missing or clipped content.
The target images are ChatGPT-generated. Text, exact poster graphics, portraits and incidental props are style/dressing cues rather than literal geometry requirements.

User constraints outrank accidental target details: preserve four identical lockers near entry in two physical banks, no mannequin/display coverall suits, exactly two briefing benches, a clear pod, open room entrances, matte timber, small bathroom tiles and used-but-maintained materials. Ordinary jackets and towels are authorized personal belongings.
Pass-07 was judged from images only; no scene script, geometry, contact-check output or passage-ray output was used to increase visual scores.
